question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4
solution:
The correct answer is 'poverty'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The passage discusses the socio-economic challenges faced by the Adivasis, one of the most marginalized communities in India.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate a condition that reflects their socio-economic struggle.
 
• "Poverty" fits well as it signifies the state of being extremely poor, which aligns with the context of the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 4'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Abundance (प्रचुरता): Refers to a large quantity of something, which contradicts the context of economic hardship.
 
• Forest (जंगल): Refers to a large area covered chiefly with trees, which is irrelevant to the socio-economic condition being described.
 
• River (नदी): Refers to a large natural stream of water, which does not fit in the context of socio-economic challenges.
